captions.detailed: This object is a dark grey/black workshop task lamp with a C-clamp base, a two-segment articulated arm, and a light grey cone-shaped reflector shade. The C-clamp is designed to attach to a table edge with a screw mechanism. The first arm segment is curved and connects to the base via a rotating joint, while the second straight arm segment connects via a pivoting elbow joint. The conical lamp shade sits on a tilting hinge at the end of the second arm segment.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of an articulated workshop vice-clamp task lamp. It should feature a C-clamp base with a screw handle, a curved lower arm segment connected to the base via a vertical revolute joint, a straight upper arm segment connected via a horizontal elbow joint, and a conical reflector shade that tilts on a hinge at the end of the upper arm.
captions.factory: The code constructs an articulated assembly of multiple parts. First, the C-clamp base is built using a combination of boxes and cylinders for the clamp frame and the screw mechanism. The lower arm is created as a curved sweep or bent cylinder, revolving on a vertical Z-axis joint relative to the clamp. The upper arm is modeled as a straight cylinder with square joint blocks at both ends, connecting to the lower arm via a horizontal Y-axis pivot. Finally, the lamp shade is constructed by subtracting a smaller cone from a larger cone (or lofting concentric circles) to form a hollow reflector, which is attached to the upper arm via another horizontal pivot joint.
